name: We'll Live - Together
source:
A linear visual novel following two protagonists on their short journey as they experience a strange alternative reality together. Watch as this world reveals their true feelings, and how one good meal really is the way to a lover's heart.

[From [url=https://soggfytoast.itch.io/well-live-together]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部线性视觉小说，讲述了两个主角一起经历奇怪的另类现实的短暂旅程。观看这个世界揭示他们的真实感受，以及如何用一顿美餐真正赢得爱人的心。

[来自[url=https://soggfytoast.itch.io/well-live-together]itch.io[/url]]
